essence: Tradition prescribes an alternative measure of one and a half angulas from the middle of the knee.
The vidyeśa-angula is defined as the middle space between the two thumbs.
Three threads should be placed on its sides extending up to the face, ear, and arm.
After placing it on the head of the pendant board, one should let it hang down.
The front-placed thread should be arranged so that it touches the nose and the belly.
